rawText:
Snehal Harde
Computer Science Student
 +91-8999646955 # snehal.harde2935@gmail.com ï linkedin.com/in/snehal-harde
Summary
Computer Science student with a strong foundation in Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. Skilled in
developing data-driven and AI-powered applications using Python and modern development tools. Passionate about
solving real-world problems through intelligent systems and continuously building practical projects in Artificial
Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Skills
Programming & Querying: Python, SQL
Data Analysis & Visualization: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib ,seaborn
Technology & Tools: VS Code, Jupyter Notebook, Git, GitHub
AI & Machine Learning: Machine Learning, Data Science, AI
Projects
Visora AI - Personal AI Tutor | Python, Data Science In Progress
- Developing Visora AI, an AI-powered live tutoring platform supporting 4 input modes: PDF/document, image, text,
and audio for personalized learning.
- Implementing an AI avatar tutor with real-time Q&A, visual explanations, diagrams, and animations to deliver
interactive lessons across 10+ planned educational topics.
- Building an adaptive quiz and evaluation system targeting 80%+ topic-assessment accuracy, with automated
scoring, mistake analysis, and correct-answer explanations.
- Developing a student analytics dashboard to track 100% of completed learning sessions, including recordings, quiz
scores, weak topics, learning progress, and personalized recommendations.
Awards & Certifications

* IBM Machine Learning Certificate - Coursera

* TechFest Data Science Workshop Certificate - 2025
Education
B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering Expected Graduation: 2027
G.H. Raisoni University, Amravati, Nagpur CGPA: 7.21 / 10
